summary.en: Terminal coding agent from Xiaomi. The v0.1.17 release ships mimocode-windows-arm64.zip.
summary.zh-TW: 小米的終端機程式碼助理，v0.1.17 版提供 mimocode-windows-arm64.zip。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
